sloka: जहि दारय चैहीति कथं विद्रवसीति च ।एवं सुतुमुलः शब्दस्तस्मिंस्तमसि शुश्रुवे ।। ६.४४.४ ।।।।
transliteration: jahi dāraya caihīti kathaṁ vidravasīti ca ।evaṁ sutumulaḥ śabdastasmiṁstamasi śuśruve ।। 6.44.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "Strike", "Tear", "Why are you running away?" were the kind of tumultuous echo heard in the darkness of the night. In that darkness the dark complexioned Vanaras and Rakshasas covered with golden armour in the night seemed like shining herbs of the forest in the mountain.
